tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a command in a shell.

findings.fix: Avoid passing unrestricted user input to shell commands.
Avoid shell execution; use a fixed executable with validated arguments.

explanations.title: Shell command injection
explanations.why_it_matters: Untrusted arguments passed to a shell can change the command being executed and cause unintended actions.
explanations.remediation: Avoid shell invocation; use a fixed executable with validated argument arrays and strict input validation.
